question: ​Which Article of the Constitution mandates the establishment of the National Commission for Scheduled Castes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 338**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 338** of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of the **National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC)**.
 
• The Commission was created to **promote and safeguard the interests of the Scheduled Castes (SCs)** in India.
 
• The **89th Amendment Act of 2003** bifurcated the earlier combined National Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes into two separate bodies – the **National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC)** and the **National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST)**.
 
• The primary functions of the NCSC include investigating and monitoring matters related to the safeguards provided to Scheduled Castes under the Constitution or other laws and evaluating their implementation.
